title: Fibonacci Number (DP)
statement: Return the n-th Fibonacci number where F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2). Use bottom-up DP (not exponential recursion).

viva.question: How does bottom-up Fibonacci avoid the exponential recursion tree?
expected_points: each value depends only on the previous two stored answers
time is linear and space can stay constant with two rolling variables
top-down recursion without memoization recomputes the same tails repeatedly

viva.question: What are F(0) and F(1)?
expected_points: F(0) is zero and F(1) is one
those identities are the recurrence base cases
the loop starts after those seeds
different bases would generate a different sequence

viva.question: Why is F(n) equal to F(n-1) plus F(n-2) enough?
expected_points: that equality is the definition of Fibonacci
overlapping subproblems are exactly those two predecessors
no other branches are missing once the bases are set
bottom-up evaluation fills them in increasing order
